findings.title: Final byte barrier can finalize after an in-place evidence mutation during its own read
findings.detail: The reader hashes the bytes returned by its single read and compares only dev/inode/size/mtime/nlink before/after. A same-inode, same-size update with restoredmtime after that read is not detected; the final capture compares stale original bytes with the original snapshot.

actual_private_probe.mutated_private_field: derived claims[0].status PASS to FAIL; same byte length

findings.required_bounded_correction: Harden the closed bounded reader with a fresh bounded byte/hash recheck after the original reader closes and coherent path/handle checks as appropriate; refuse drift without retry/waiver, keep all403 final admission and sticky failure. Add this exact actual-method final-read same-size+restoredmtime mutation, verify finalize/output refusal and absence of raw data leakage. Merely rereading once at the batch boundary is insufficient because that read itself is affected.
findings.limits: This is a concrete in-flight read integrity counterexample, not a request for perpetual filesystem atomicity. It is an adapter source-contract defect, not a failure or reinterpretation of the closed actual Six run.

independent_checks.qualification: The existing12 pass, but they do not cancel the additional counterexample. Current same-size test mutates before final read and does not cover mutation inside that final read.
